question: How many pregame win-prob points is each team's top on/off player worth vs a league-average opponent (neutral site)?
assumptions_and_floors: on/off deltas are pre-floored by the source claim (min_on>=500, n_games>=30).
net-rating->Elo conversion is a single FROZEN constant, anchored to HFA, not fit.
star_elo subtracted linearly from team Elo; nonlinearity of the logistic curve means the same on/off delta yields a larger win-prob swing for mid-strength teams.
win prob is vs a league-average (1500) opponent on a neutral floor, NOT a real matchup.
